subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - Cobalt Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cobalt-commerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - Cobalt Commerce

Hi Samir -

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

Call recap:
- Goals: reduce inference cost on personalization models, improve 95th-pct latency for user-facing recommendations, and eliminate occasional rate-limit errors during peak traffic.
- Current infra: mixed on-prem + cloud GPU fleet; buying decision spans Eng, Security, and Procurement.
- Success criteria mentioned: throughput 3x current with <150ms p95, SOC2 evidence, and pricing within procurement guardrails.

As discussed, could you help map the key stakeholders so we can tailor the next deck and procurement materials? Specifically: 
1) Economic buyer (final sign-off on spend) - name/title
2) Security/Compliance lead (SOC 2, audit evidence) - name/title
3) Procurement / Sourcing contact (contracts, terms, timeline) - name/title and typical PO process
4) Any other influencers (SRE, Data Privacy, Legal) and preferred intro chain

Proposed next steps:
- You share the brief stakeholder list/org chart (PDF or doc) - I can incorporate into the mutual action plan.
- I'll send a short technical appendix (SOC2 + audit artifacts summary) for Elena and Security.
- Schedule a short alignment call with Procurement once we have buyer info - 30 minutes.

If easier, feel free to reply with a quick org chart or forward the appropriate folks and I'll loop them in.

Attaching a one-pager template that helps with mapping if useful.

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood-stakeholder-template.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cobalt-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rodriguez <elena.rodriguez@cobalt-commerce.com>, Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@cobalt-commerce.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - Cobalt Commerce

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and list. Attaching a quick org chart and a short note on the procurement timeline. High-level:

- Economic buyer: Priya Kothari, VP of Product (priya.kothari@cobalt-commerce.com) - primary sign-off for infra/third-party SaaS spend over $100k.
- Security/Compliance: Elena Rodriguez, Head of Security (cc'd) - she'll want SOC2 + data residency details.
- Procurement: Marcus Liu, Sr. Procurement Manager (cc'd) - handles SOW/PO and standard T&Cs; typical cycle is 4-6 weeks once commercial terms are agreed.
- Influencers: SRE lead (Carlos Mendes, carlos.mendes@cobalt-commerce.com) and Legal (Tina Park, tina.park@cobalt-commerce.com).

I've attached: Cobalt_org_chart_v1.pdf and a short procurement timeline doc. Elena and Marcus are on-copy - Elena, Marcus, Marissa from Redwood is owning the next tech/security packet.

We'd like to see:
- SOC2 report summary and a short note on data residency options (VPC/on-prem discussion).
- A ballpark pricing cadence (list vs committed) and options for a pilot.

Happy to stand up a 30-minute alignment call next week. Marcus - is Wed 3/25 10-10:30am PT an option?

Best,
Samir
CTO, Cobalt Commerce
Attachments: Cobalt_org_chart_v1.pdf, Cobalt_procurement_timeline.pdf

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for looping me in. A few security asks up front so we can evaluate fit quickly: 
- SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary of controls (redacted where needed).
- Data residency / VPC options and support for customer-managed KMS.
- Incident response SLAs and audit logging details.

If you can send a short one-page security appendix that addresses those bullets, I will share with Tina (Legal) and Carlos (SRE). Marcus - if we move to pilot, procurement will need a sample SOW and typical commercial terms to estimate cycle time.

Thanks,
Elena Rodriguez
Head of Security, Cobalt Commerce

Hi all -

Great, thanks for the org chart and clarity on the stakeholders. Quick follow-ups and what I'll send by EOD: 

1) Security appendix (one-pager) addressing: SOC2 Type II summary, data residency/VPC options, KMS support, and logging/incident response. (Neha - I've looped you in to review before I send.)
2) Pilot proposal: a 4-week pilot scope, target metrics (p95 latency, throughput targets), and a pricing estimate for both list/hosted and a committed pilot.
3) Sample SOW and standard commercial terms for Marcus and Procurement to review.

Marcus - Wed 3/25 10-10:30am PT works for us; I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Neha - could you add a short note on expected artifacts and the minimal evidence Elena will need to move this quickly? A bulleted checklist is perfect.

Thanks - we'll keep this tight.

Best,
